# spectral_connectivity

> Multitaper spectral estimates and frequency-domain connectivity measures
> (coherence, phase locking, spectral Granger causality, directed transfer
> functions, ...) for multichannel electrophysiology time series, with labeled
> xarray results.

Use `multitaper_connectivity(time_series, sampling_frequency=..., method=...)`
with `time_series` shaped `(n_time_samples, n_trials, n_signals)`. Call
`list_measures()` for every valid `method` and what its values mean. In the
wrapper's results, `result.sel(source="a", target="b")` is the influence of `a`
on `b`; the lower-level `Connectivity` arrays use the same source-first order,
`result[..., i, j]` is `i -> j` for every directed measure.

## Docs

- [Guide for AI coding assistants](https://spectral-connectivity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/llm_guide.html): the workflow, direction conventions, parameter choice, and API pitfalls
- [Choosing a measure](https://spectral-connectivity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/choosing_a_measure.html): which measure answers which question, and the scientific pitfalls (single observations, small-sample bias, diagonals, directed measures)
- [Cookbook](https://spectral-connectivity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cookbook.html): short recipes for common tasks
- [Migrating from 2.x to 3.0](https://spectral-connectivity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/migration.html): what code written for 2.x has to change
- [Connectivity Metric Ranges](https://spectral-connectivity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/CONNECTIVITY_METRIC_RANGES.html): range, units, orientation, and interpretation of every measure
- [API reference](https://spectral-connectivity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html): every public function and class
